definition: Shanghai Jieyue Xingchen Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd, known as StepFun, is an artificial intelligence (AI) company based in Shanghai, China.
details: It has been dubbed one of China's 6 "AI Tiger" companies by investors.

explainer.lead: StepFun is an AI company based in Shanghai, China, formally Shanghai Jieyue Xingchen Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. Investors have called it one of China's six "AI Tiger" companies.

tiers.eli5: It's a company in China that builds artificial intelligence, and people compare it to the big cats of the tech world.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers may encounter StepFun as a model or tool provider in the Chinese AI market. A pitfall is treating its products as interchangeable with others without checking availability and licensing in a given region.
tiers.paperLevel: StepFun is an organisation rather than a formal construct, so no definition or formula applies; its known limit is simply that the company is described as one of six Chinese "AI Tiger" firms.

explainer.example: A team comparing AI vendors lists StepFun alongside other Chinese firms as one of the six "AI Tiger" companies.
